description: One of the knowledge base's engines: a provider and a model its Inference document names, and the jobs the document has it used for. An engine is not a principal: whichever worker claims a job does it, under its own account, and names on each write the engine it used, if any. Carries no inference limits: the services that hold the inference credentials report those (InferenceLimitsResult).

jobs.description: The jobs the knowledge base's Inference document has this engine used for, as a claim names them. Absent for an engine only Librarian actors ask.
